text: The university library is open from 9 AM to 8 PM on working days. Students must carry their university identity cards to access the library.
Students can borrow up to three books at a time. The standard borrowing period is fourteen days, subject to university library rules.
Students should contact the university IT helpdesk for official assistance with university email accounts and campus network connectivity.
Students should consult the official academic calendar and university examination notifications for examination dates.
The university identity card should be presented when requested by authorised university staff.
UNVERIFIED NOTICE: The university library closes at 5 PM on all working days. Students should not rely on other library timings until this notice is verified.
UNVERIFIED NOTICE: Students may borrow up to ten books at a time from the university library. This claim has not been verified against official library rules.
UNVERIFIED NOTICE: Examination dates are announced only through unofficial student groups, and students do not need to check the official academic calendar.
